independent_source_review.scope: Read-only source review of the frozen AAAtrig Lawson/degree candidate; no numerical run

rejected_initial_concern.topic: economy SVD shape for wide Lawson matrix
rejected_initial_concern.resolution: Candidate uses full JAX SVD when rows < columns and selects vh[-1].conj(). MATLAB svd(A,0) is documented to equal full SVD for m<=n, so this matches V(:,end). Candidate uses reduced SVD for tall matrices, selecting the last right singular vector there as well.
rejected_initial_concern.reference: https://www.mathworks.com/help/matlab/ref/double.svd.html (svd(A,0) versus svd(A,"econ"), lines 53-56; independently supplied by root reviewer)

review_findings.coverage_recommendation: Add a focused wide-matrix Lawson control with M < 2*n_support to protect the full-SVD behavior; current candidate controls use enough samples that this branch is not covered.
native_match_checks: Cauchy/value columns are interleaved as native A=[A cst, F.*cst].
Support rows are zeroed and restored with alternating 2 and 2*F entries.
The numerator and denominator use the native ordered j accumulation and signs.
Weights start at ones, update as wt.*abs(error), and normalize by infinity norm.
Adaptive Lawson runs at least 20 and at most 1000 steps, continuing while maxerr/maxerrold < .999.
Rollback applies only to adaptive Lawson when final error exceeds pre-Lawson error.
Explicit degree or mmax enables adaptive Lawson unless lawson=0; degree/mmax consistency is checked.
Two-sample correction restores both support values, antisymmetric normalized weights, zero second error, and zero baseline error before Lawson.
Cleanup is run only when cleanup is enabled and nlawson equals zero.
documented_scope_limits: Greedy support selection and pole/zero generalized eigenproblem remain NumPy/SciPy inherited paths.
Infinity-sample constraints and warning behavior, AutoZ/string inputs, source RNG fixture, and complete native predicate coverage remain outside this candidate scope.
No bitwise MATLAB identity claim is made for JAX SVD arithmetic.

independent_source_review.qualification_status: Source review only; candidate remains unlaunched and unmodified.

wide_SVD_semantics.finding: The zero argument differs from econ: at rows<=columns it requests full SVD. Native V(:,end) therefore selects a nullspace vector when the matrix is wide. Candidate keeps fullV in that case.
wide_SVD_semantics.review_correction: Independent reviewer retracted initial econ-based objection after checking primary documentation.
wide_SVD_semantics.control: 3x4literal Lawson matrix has analytical nullspace span[4,-2,-5,1]; reducedV omits required direction.
